calibratedAt: CP-0 for the fixed and ratio terms; the carrier term from the generator's own measurement
note: outputBytes <= fixedAllowanceBytes + inputBytes * maxByteRatio + carriers * perCarrierBytes. The fixed term is the document-level declaration plus the floor of chaff a region receives regardless of its size. The per-carrier term exists because a carrier's cost is set by the word it draws and not by the page it sits on: about 900 bytes of path markup per word, measured, whether the document is 500 bytes or 50 KB. Folding either into the ratio makes the ratio meaningless — the fixed term below a few kilobytes, the carrier term on any page that protects more than it publishes. Ceilings are only ever tightened (ROADMAP.md).
